figurative_meaning_en: to go hungry, not eating anything
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে দিনভর কাজ করে হাওয়া খেয়েছে।
ভাত না খেয়ে হাওয়া খাওয়া কষ্টের কাজ।
example_sentences_in_english: He worked all day and went hungry.
Going without food and just eating air is tough.
note: Often used sarcastically to imply lack of sustenance or intelligence in a light-hearted scolding manner
